title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.

title: Yeidhavan
desc: When Krishna's sister is killed during a college protest, he vows to avenge her. However, he ends up helping the medical students to gain their rights.

title: Ulavuthurai
desc: Vasanth Periyasamy, a naval officer, is assigned to investigate the mysterious deaths at the sea. To protect his family, he assumes the identity of a car driver.

title: Maayavi
desc: Abhes, a con man, kidnaps famous actress Jyothika in an act of revenge after she sends him to prison. As her family searches for her, Jyothika comes to understand Abhes' true character.

title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.
